name: Sanzensekai no Ko o Koroshi
source:
Tomorrow night, the female head of their household, Hasumi, is to create a child with a man she meets for the first time, as decreed by the elders of their clan.
       One time, she tried to escape this fate to the point of nearly dying. How will she spend her last day before that cursed yet promised night, with Yashiro— her chaperone— who once intervened with her attempt to die and saved her?

[Translated from the [url=http://rocotsu.main.jp/snkk/index.html]official website[/url].]
translation:
按照族中长老的命令，明晚，家族女主人蓮美必须与一名素未谋面的男子生下孩子。

她曾经试图逃离这个命运，甚至差点丧命。如今，在那个受到诅咒却又注定会到来的夜晚之前，她将如何与曾阻止她寻死、救过她的随侍八代共度最后一天？[译自[url=http://rocotsu.main.jp/snkk/index.html]官方网站[/url]]
